description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, including nested classes for configuration management, JSON serialization, and path substitution. It provides mechanisms for handling plugin configurations, environment variables, and network settings, and includes methods for updating and accessing configuration data.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class managing plugin, network, and environment settings, including nested classes for JSON serialization and path substitution.

classes.name: Config::Substituter
classes.description: Handles variable substitution within configuration paths using defined variables.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: Represents the JSON structure for configuration, including nested classes for environment variables, process settings, input configuration, observables, and optional Hibernate and ProcessContainer configurations.

classes.name: Config::InputInfo
classes.description: Stores information about input device configuration, such as locator, type, and enabled status.

classes.name: Config::ProcessInfo
classes.description: Stores process-related configuration details like user, group, priority, OOM adjustment, policy, and UMask.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Updates network binding address based on current configuration.

methods.name: Config::Security
methods.description: Sets the security interface for the configuration.

methods.name: Config::Plugin
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin configuration by name.

methods.name: Config::Plugins
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the plugin configurations.

methods.name: Config::Add
methods.description: Adds a new plugin configuration if it does not already exist.

methods.name: Config::UpdateAccessor
methods.description: Updates the network accessor node ID based on current binding and interface settings.

methods.name: Config::URL
methods.description: Returns the constructed URL based on current network settings.
